Phase 2 (P7 booking history, P8 multi-item booking composer, P9 loyalty+reviews, P4 unified Explore, P5 palette refine) is DEFERRED to a later round — do NOT implement Phase 2 now.
stack: typescript; backend=NestJS 11+Prisma+PostgreSQL localhost:54322 (existing DB, do NOT create a new one); web=Next.js 16 App Router+Tailwind v4 CSS-first (tokens in web/app/globals.css)+next-intl+zod+react-query; ai=Python3.12 FastAPI hand-rolled tool loop (vibe-booking/agent/tools/_defs.py + TOOL_DISPATCH, NOT LangGraph — no graph.py exists); pm:npm; envelope {success,data,message,error}; /v1 JWT, /v1/ai-tools X-Service-Key; dev ports 4007 (backend) / 4008 (web) / 4009 (vibe-booking) via shell env overrides
flow: Phase 1 order: (1) backend edits prisma/schema.prisma — all Phase 1 enums/fields/models in ONE pass, then run migrations: add_hotel_type, guide_languages_specialties_packages, vehicle_tier_subtype, custom_trips. (2) reseed (prisma/seeds 05-hotels, 06-transportation, 07-guides). (3) backend module code: hotels (type filter+mapper), guides (languages/specialties/trips), transportation (tier/subtype), ai-tools (POST /v1/ai-tools/trips for custom trips + P1-P3 fields). (4) vibe-booking: .env MODEL_LLM=openai/gpt-oss-120b + MODEL_TIMEOUT_S=25 + retries 4->2; websocket.py structured error frame; create_trip tool in _defs.py + TOOL_DISPATCH + handler + _norm_custom_trip; system prompt. (5) web: catalog-browse slice (domain.ts+resources.ts+hotels/guides/transport pages) + custom-trip-card slice (vibe-payloads.ts+block-renderer.tsx+new component). Mirror EVERY schema change in backend/context/specs/SCHEMA.md. Add error codes to backend/context/specs/ERROR-REGISTRY.md.
constraints: DB already exists on localhost:54322 — do NOT create a new one. Migrations via `npx prisma migrate dev` from backend/.
Mirror schema.prisma changes in backend/context/specs/SCHEMA.md per repo convention.
forbidNonWhitelisted: true — every new query param MUST be declared in the DTO or requests return 400.
zod schemas: new backend fields additive + optional so parsing never breaks.
ai-tools responses are snake_case; agent _norm_* converters turn them into camelCase payloads — update normalizer AND web payload schema together.
TOOL_DISPATCH path must match ai-tools.controller.ts route exactly.
Relaunching vibe-booking requires shell-exported NVIDIA_API_KEY to be UNSET (RAYU.md gotcha — else 403 every turn).
Dropping the old GuideSpeciality table: grep remaining references + rewrite guide seed BEFORE migrating.
Enum ALTER TYPE is add-only and safe, but SupportedLanguage/TripCategory extensions MUST migrate before any code writes the new values.
web/messages/{en,zh,km}.json edits from multiple slices must be merged sequentially (orchestrator merges).

File ownership to avoid parallel conflicts: catalog-browse slice OWNS web/schemas/domain.ts + web/lib/api/resources.ts + web/app/[locale]/{hotels,guides,transport}/**; custom-trip-card slice OWNS web/schemas/vibe-payloads.ts + web/components/chat/payloads/**. Backend schema.prisma + migrations are shared — serialize internally.
